title: Recombination Equals Reconstruction
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a finite set of nonzero elements of $F$, and let $f$ assign a field element to each nonzero element of $F$. Recombining the values of $f$ from $A$ equals the reconstruction of those values by the scheme that shares a secret using a polynomial $s+Xq(X)$ with $\deg q<k-1$ and reconstructs by interpolation at zero.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
$f$ is a function from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$
